jobs.description: In this position, you will have the opportunity to learn the operator profession step by step. You will work with modern production machines that produce paper bags and will be responsible for the smooth running of the production process. At the beginning of your shift, you prepare the production orders and ensure that the correct materials are available. You then set up the machines, closely monitor the production process, and regularly check the quality of the final product. During your work, you will learn how to identify and resolve minor malfunctions, so that production can continue without interruptions.In addition, you will ensure that production data is processed correctly and, together with your colleagues, contribute to a safe, clean, and tidy working environment. You will work in a 3-shift system, with the day shift taking place on Monday from 6:55 AM to 3:05 PM and from Tuesday to Friday from 6:45 AM to 3:05 PM. The evening shift is from Monday to Thursday from 2:45 PM to 11:05 PM and on Friday from 2:45 PM to 8:00 PM. The night shift runs from Monday to Thursday from 10:45 PM to 7:05 AM. Because the night shift consists of four nights, you finish on Friday morning and always have a full weekend off. Thanks to the extensive training programme, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself into an independent operator. Experience as an operator is not necessary; technical insight, a willingness to learn, and motivation are the most important qualities for this position. You will join a committed team where cooperation is central and where you will have plenty of opportunities to grow within the production department. This position is based in Zwaag and offers an excellent opportunity to build a great career - You have a good command of the Dutch or English language- You have technical insight- You enjoy working with machines- You are willing to work in a shift system- Living in the Zwaag, Hoorn, or Medemblik area is an advantage

What you'll do:  - Join a friendly team of platform engineers and pick up a project of your own, with a mentor to guide you - Help build reports and dashboards that show how AI tools are used across TomTom and what they cost - Look into how engineers can get good results from AI tools while using fewer tokens, and share simple tips and tooling with them - Help improve our model gateway, for example by adding usage tracking or making it easier for teams to try new models - Take part in trying out new AI developer tools and help write down what works and what does not - Support the pilot of our AI-assisted ways of working with engineering teams, for example by collecting feedback and usage numbers - Build iteratively using agile methodologies, and learn how a platform team works day to day  What you'll need:  - Being enrolled in a Dutch university until at least September 2027, so the entire duration of the internship - Being located in Amsterdam or cities close by to be able to commute to the office at least twice a week - Available for at least 32h/week - Good Python skills - Some experience using AI coding assistants or LLM APIs, for example in coursework or a side project - Basic knowledge of working with data (SQL, pandas or similar) - Nice to have: experience with GitHub Actions, APIs or a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) - Solid Computer Science fundamentals - Comfortable with written and/or verbal communication in English - Curious about AI and eager to learn

Allround Process Operator in 2 shifts  Tussen €2.723 en €3.770 Per maand  Beschrijving Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit? You start your day by going through the production schedule and then flush the machines with water before starting production. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the correct materials are ready and that the production lines are operational. Using the forklift, you ensure that all products are in the right place. You set up machines, monitor the parameters and carry out quality tests. You record and document all your findings. If you notice a deviation or a fault, you look for a solution and make adjustments where necessary. You also carry out minor technical maintenance and contribute ideas for improvements. At the end of the day, you get to work cleaning the machine so that production can start again the following day. You'll work with various machines and production lines, which keeps your work nicely varied. Step by step, as a trainee all-round process operator, you'll get to know all the processes and, within 6 to 12 months, you'll progress to become a fully-fledged All-round Process Operator. Specifically, you'll spend 25 % of your time on cleaning, 25 % on quality and parameter checks and 50 % operating the machines. Wat breng je mee? - A completed MBO 4 qualification, preferably in a technical field (Process Operator, VAPRO, MAS or MTS) or demonstrable experience in the field; - Experience as an operator in the food industry; - Technical understanding and an interest in improving production processes; - An independent, meticulous and eager-to-learn approach to work; - A good command of Dutch and/or English; - A forklift licence or a willingness to obtain one; - Willingness to work shifts, excluding night shifts. Ready to progress to the role of All-round Process Operator? Then we'd love to meet you! Wat mag je verwachten? - A salary based on your work experience, but definitely between €2,723.5...

jobs.description: As a warehouse operator at DSV Contract Logistics B.V., you make sure goods move quickly and safely to the right place. You’ll work in a close-knit team, get lots of responsibility, and learn every day. This is your chance to really make an impact in logistics! Wat ga je doen? As a warehouse operator, you’re the key player in the logistics process. You unload trucks and containers, stack goods on pallets, and make sure everything is scanned, labeled, and shrink-wrapped correctly. You use internal transport equipment like forklifts and reach trucks to move everything quickly and safely. You count inventory, pick orders, and get them ready for shipping. You also help with value-added activities like packaging or labeling products. You’ll work full time (40 hours a week), mostly in day shifts. Together with your colleagues, you keep the warehouse tidy and safe. You work closely with your team leader and supervisor, and your day flies by thanks to the variety of tasks. Speed, accuracy, and safety are always at the heart of your job as a warehouse operator. Waar ga je werken? DSV Contract Logistics B.V. Is a global leader in transport and logistics. At the Moerdijk location, you will work in one of the largest and most advanced warehouses in the Netherlands and the surrounding region, equipped with the latest warehouse technology.Safety, teamwork, and a well-organized workplace are top priorities. DSV values its employees by providing clear communication, structured planning, and plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development. Wie ben je? This is what we ask from you:- You are at least 18 years old and have a VMBO level of education or equivalent working and thinking level;- You have a good command of the English language;- You enjoy working as part of a team;- You live within commuting distance of Moerdijk and have your own transportation; Wat mag je verwachten? This is what we offer you: - A starting salary between €15,55 and €16,03
